desc:
🎲 ROLL AN ANIME DEFENDER 🛡️
Roll anime units, max out your LUCK, and defend your base from waves of enemies and bosses!

🎁 CODE: RELEASE
Redeem it for free rewards! More codes in our group.

[ HOW TO PLAY ]
🎲 ROLL for units from Common all the way to SECRET
🛡️ PLACE your units on your base and stop the enemy waves
⚔️ CLEAR every Story world and beat each world's boss
🐉 DEFEAT bosses for a rare FAMILIAR that fights at your side
🏰 CLIMB the Tower and see how far your team can go
🌀 OPEN GATES with friends: 50 waves, powerful boons and gate-only units!
🍀 UPGRADE your luck to roll better units
🔮 CRAFT Relics, reroll Traits and fill your Index for even more luck
⏩ UNLOCK faster Battle Speeds as you clear every world

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a LIKE and FAVOURITE!
🔔 Join GROUP for updates and new codes!

📱 Supported devices: PC • Mobile • Tablet • Console
